about: The caves' look (the Undermere, first person): one look for every cave file, read by meshy_cave_build.py. The exposure, the fog and wdi_baked are the network's and go into every cave's Area extras exactly as written here (contract docs/walk-areas.md, world.cave_look). Colours are sRGB hex. Light kinds: a lamp only at a gate (lamp group), the night sky through a mouth (sky group), dim fill lights in the chambers and the wide passages (fill group), and AO.
status: P0 prototype (2026-11-21): not frozen. E, the scene exposure the light is graded at, is the Swallow's lamp pool at its first full bake (384 samples, 2026-11-21): every cave is graded at it, so the light matches across seams

lamp.about_emit: COLOR_0-free emitters (linear, at most 1): the glass shows #F0B481 and the lamp's iron cap, base and bracket #382C22 through the viewer's exposure and AgX (route 1: the P0 glass at glass_display read as a flat grey box)

hot.about: display luminance over knee is eased towards max; timber (the guards' rails and the gates' railway timbers, creosoted) has its own lower knee and max, as the grille has its iron cap (route 1 fix: the Cutting Gate's centre post 0.3 m under the lamp read as a cream bar)

iron_display.about: a gate's grille: display luminance held between ink_margin x the ink and cap, its hue the iron's grey warmed towards the lamp's colour by up to warm where the lamp gives the light (route 1: the P0 bars read cream in a saturated blue frame)
